text: Grade 6 Science, Environment unit: students classify the components of the environment into biotic (living) and abiotic (non-living) components, using examples from their immediate surroundings.

text: Grade 6 Science, Environment unit: students identify producers, consumers, and decomposers as groups of biotic components at an introductory level and give a local example of each.

text: Grade 6 Science, Environment unit: students relate everyday local objects (rice plant, goat, mushroom, soil, river water, sunlight) to the correct environmental component and justify the classification.
